1. Executive Summary

Diagnostic overview of the scan test execution across lots.

During test execution, a total of 3,560 failure records were collected and parsed across 9 lots (containing 45 failing dice). Physical scan diagnostics identified 14 scan chain breaks causing systematic shift-path failures. The remaining failure signatures were classified using timing slack parameters and anomalous behavior profiles, separating capture timing violations (setup/hold) from functional cell defects.
